summary: Verified deploy-probe fix: root-level /health and /api/health respond 200 on GET+HEAD at backend pod (port 8001). Regression endpoints /api/wallet/ticker and /api/categories still return 200. Fix is correct and unblocks Kubernetes liveness/readiness probes.
critical_code_review_comments: Health endpoints correctly declared before large router body; both GET and HEAD variants present.
External /health via public ingress hits frontend HTML (expected — ingress routes non-/api to frontend on port 3000). K8s probes bypass ingress and hit pod:8001 directly, so this is fine.
server.py is 8445 lines — long-term should be split into routers/modules, but out of scope for this probe-only fix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health probe fix verified via curl to http://localhost:8001. Both /health and /api/health return 200 on GET and HEAD. No regressions on /api/wallet/ticker or /api/categories.
